Presidential Election 1988

Source: R/Data.R
Election1988.Rd

Results of the Sri Lankan presidential election held in 1988, extracted from PDF result tables and prepared as Election1988.

Usage

data(Election1988)

Format

A data frame with 6 columns.

Year

Year of the presidential election.

District

Electoral district name.

Electorate

Polling-division name, Postal District Votes, or Final District Results.

ColNames

Candidate name or summary label: Total No of Valid Votes, No of Rejected Votes, Total No of Votes Polled, or No of Registered Electors.

Votes

Candidate vote count or the count associated with a summary label. Registered-elector rows contain elector counts rather than votes.

Percentage

Reported or recalculated percentage on a 0–100 scale. The denominator depends on the row type. Missing values indicate percentages that were not supplied or calculated.

Source

Election Commission of Sri Lanka: https://elections.gov.lk/en/elections/results_pre_E.html.

Data extraction and preparation: https://github.com/Amalan-ConStat/PresidentialElection.

Details

Three candidates contested this election.

Preparation included selected percentage calculations for Trincomalee, Badulla, Kurunegala, and Baddegama in Galle. Postal registered-elector rows with missing counts were removed. Remaining missing counts and selected associated percentages were replaced with zero.

District totals and their component results are both included. These reporting levels should be analysed separately to avoid double-counting.

Examples

data(Election1988)
Election1988[Election1988$District == "Colombo" & Election1988$Electorate == "Colombo-North", ]
#> # A tibble: 7 × 6
#>    Year District Electorate    ColNames                         Votes Percentage
#>   <int> <chr>    <chr>         <chr>                            <dbl>      <dbl>
#> 1  1988 Colombo  Colombo-North Mr.Ranasinghe Premadasa          22389      63.3 
#> 2  1988 Colombo  Colombo-North Mrs.Sirimavo Ratwatte Dias Band… 10744      30.4 
#> 3  1988 Colombo  Colombo-North Mr.Ahangama Vithanage Oswin Nan…  2259       6.38
#> 4  1988 Colombo  Colombo-North Total No of Valid Votes          35392      98.2 
#> 5  1988 Colombo  Colombo-North No of Rejected Votes               647       1.8 
#> 6  1988 Colombo  Colombo-North Total No of Votes Polled         36039      66.6 
#> 7  1988 Colombo  Colombo-North No of Registered Electors        54149      NA
